summary: CPS Technologies filed an 8-K reporting third-quarter fiscal 2026 results via press release dated November 3, 2026, with an accompanying financial results exhibit. Revenue was $8.9 million, gross margin 20.9%, and operating profit $0.4 million, with margin expansion and record quarterly revenue cited. The release also notes a first order from a defense contractor for tungsten alloy components made with proprietary QuickSet Injection Molding, plus plans for a new facility. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or ownership/regulatory mechanics appear; this is a routine earnings current report with no special-situation arbitrage angle.
